svg.title: South Cariboo Community Health Council — reconstructed colour logo
svg.desc: New historical reconstruction, 22 November 2026. Two independently rebuilt conifers and four lines of fitted ITC Souvenir Demi-style lettering. Original colour source: 315 by 141 JPEG in Health Plan approved 1 November 1999; surviving PDF created May 2000. Not an original vector master.
svg.metadata: {"status": "reconstruction", "created": "2026-11-22", "source_dimensions": [315, 141], "colors": ["#417A3A", "#9BBC95"], "color_status": "sampled RGB estimates, not official brand standards", "sources": ["https://web.archive.org/web/20000915110312id_/http://www2.bcinternet.net:80/~100mile/health/healthplan99.pdf", "https://hello.monotype.com/rs/800-DWE-978/images/MT_TypeTrends_FreeFonts_TypeSpecimen.pdf"], "method": "Manual branch tiers, geometric Boolean openings, fitted typeface outlines; no autotracing.", "typeface_status": "ITC Souvenir Demi is the closest tested visual match; historical vendor and font file unverified."}
